newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BCP IN NOVEL EURO-ESCUDO BOND ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: BCP IN NOVEL EURO-ESCUDO BOND ISSUE.

text.p: The Banco Comercial Portugues-Banco Portugues do Atlantico group is about to launch a two-year, four billion escudo bond issue repayable in either escudos or euros, the future European currency, lead-manager Banco Cisf said.
Banco Cisf said in a statement that it was the first such Portuguese debt issue to be launched with the single currency in mind.

The issue carries nominal interest of 3.5 percent and will be repaid on March 7, 1999, two months after the launch of economic and monetary union (EMU), in escudos or euros at the rate of 200 escudos to the euro.

"The investor benefits from any appreciation of the national currency in the run-up to monetary union and, simultaneously, is protected against the adverse effect of any eventual devaluation," the statement said.
Details of the issue as follows:
ISSUER: BCP & BPA AMOUNT: Four billion escudos
PRICE: Par INTEREST: 3.5 pct PAYMENT FREQUENCY: Annual
